# Abate

Abate is a light and dark Obsidian theme that softens tones toward a paper-like reading experience. Its recorded palette is Everforest-inspired, and it pairs that with a slick scrollbar and coloured headings styled after Word.

![Abate screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ricedev10/Abate-theme/HEAD/ScreenshotPreview.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Abate"
    author: "ricedev10"
    repo:   "ricedev10/Abate-theme"
    slug:   "abate"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/abate"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/ricedev10/Abate-theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ricedev10/Abate-theme/HEAD/ScreenshotPreview.png"

    modes: ["light"]
    about: "Apply a custom light and dark theme that softens tones for a paper-like reading experience. Use an Everforest-inspired color palette with a slick scrollbar and Word-style colored headings for clear, comfortable notes."
}
```
